subject.title: feat(codex): continue paired-node Codex catalog sessions from the Control UI

question: Should paired-node Codex supervision use the existing one-shot `codex exec resume` node binding now, or remain view-only until a streaming node bridge carries the full native lifecycle?
rationale: The PR reuses an established node-resume path, but current public documentation deliberately reserves remote supervision continuation for a future streaming bridge and the new generic plugin result seam has not received visible product-contract confirmation.

options.title: Accept one-shot continuation
options.body: Approve this architecture after live proof and document its capability and limitations relative to the full Codex harness.

options.title: Wait for streaming bridge
options.body: Keep paired-node supervision view-only and defer continuation until native events, approvals, and streaming lifecycle can cross the node transport.

recommendation.title: Accept one-shot continuation
recommendation.body: Approve this architecture after live proof and document its capability and limitations relative to the full Codex harness.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the immediately preceding merged session-catalog work and the current implementation, making them the strongest available routing candidate for this decision.
